title: Nightly 2026-10-14 follow-up UI fixes
description: Two layout fixes from the 2026-10-14 nightly sweep, shown with the real app against a mocked game. 1) The corner toast column stops below the "Prepare your secondary" chip instead of covering it (run s2-36-0118: three click timeouts on the chip). 2) Once the game is over, the read-only turn bar ("Waiting for ...", every button "Not your turn") is no longer shown under the Game Over banner (run o2-186-0210). npm run screenshots -- EF regenerates the shots and asserts: the chip's centre is not covered (elementFromPoint), the toast column starts below the chip, the chip opens the prepare banner, and no turn bar after game over.

shots.heading: Toasts and the prepare chip, 1280x720
shots.caption: Three dice toasts and three action toasts of the primary's Politics action. The column ends right below the chip: the oldest toast is cut off at the top (all of them stay in Recent notifications) and the chip can be clicked, which the capture does.

shots.heading: Toasts and the prepare chip, 1440x900
shots.caption: Same with more room: the six toasts fit below the chip without being cut.

shots.heading: Game over during the action phase
shots.caption: The banner says Game Over and there is no turn bar any more; before, the read-only bar kept saying "Waiting for ..." with every button "Not your turn".

notes.title: No before shots
notes.text: The before state is described by the nightly failure screenshots (s2-36-0118 prep-planning-threw-seat3-r2.png, o2-186-0210 no-game-over-banner.png); this folder regenerates only the fixed layout.

notes.title: Not changed
notes.text: The single-player toast column still paints below the overlay layer (sp-notification-log); the new limit applies online and offline.
